payload.title: Ship a stock image blob processor + magic-byte sniffer
payload.description: Frick owns the blob pipeline but apps supply the validate hook. Reference impl: ~/dev/aquariusyacht/apps/backend/src/domains/media/processor.ts — sniffImageFormat (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP magic bytes) plus a size-capped, mime-checked image validator that rejects non-images before they hit storage. Entirely generic; only the size cap and the rejection copy are app config. Ship sniffImageFormat as a utility and a configurable imageBlobProcessor({ maxBytes, message }) factory from @fricken/server.
